verdict.rationale: Omnara documents launching agents without the dashboard through its CLI, REST API (with a published OpenAPI spec), and TypeScript SDK. API keys used as bearer tokens, with scoped roles, support unattended, non-interactive automation. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Launch your first agent with Omnara via the dashboard, or programmatically with the CLI, the REST API, or the TypeScript SDK.
Omnara provides an **API**, **Typescript SDK**, and **CLI** to interact with Omnara
Send either key as a bearer token.
Assign organization and project roles to users and API keys.
